title: Pinned local presentation of a single-open Hom colimit comparison
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram, $c$ a cocone, and $i\in I$. Let $s_0:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ be locally finitely presented and qcqs, and $t:Y\to X$ an open immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $s:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ be locally finitely presented and qcqs with $s=t\mathbin{\gg}s_0$. Fix derived module categories in universe $w$ on every scheme and on every localized open module site of $Y$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $W$ be a compact open of $X$ contained in the image of $t$. Let $P,Q\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ be perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], $F:I_{\ge i}\to D(\mathcal O_Y)$ a diagram, $d$ a cocone, and $h$ representing push-pull data natural in every testing object, with the specified stage and apex transport equations [lem-pc-perfect-hom-push-pull-cocone]. Put $H=R(t^{-1}W\hookrightarrow Y)_*\circ\operatorname{res}_{t^{-1}W}$ [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data] and let $T(E)=\operatorname{ULift}\operatorname{Hom}(P,E[0])$ as an abelian group. Then the canonical abelian-group colimit comparison $m:\operatorname{colim}_j T(H(F_j))\to T(H(d.\mathrm{pt}))$, induced by $T(H(d_j))$, satisfies $\operatorname{PerfectHomLocalComparison}(R,c,i,X,s_0,W,m)$ [def-pc-perfect-hom-local-comparison]. No continuity or invertibility assumption on $m$ is made.

proof.text: Apply perfect_hom_open_stage_presentation at shift zero. It supplies Z, k, s′, the localized derived categories, perfect P′ and Q′, the stage equivalences e_j and apex equivalence b, and their equations for perfectStageMap and perfectLimitMap. These are presentations before taking a colimit; they do not assert the present conclusion.

The tail I_{≥i} contains i and is directed by common upper bounds. Forget abelian groups to types. Mathlib preservation of filtered colimits by forget AddCommGrpCat, shrunk from size max u w to u, makes the underlying canonical group-colimit cocone a colimit in Type.

Use the objects and equivalences from step 1 in the existential definition of PerfectHomLocalComparison. For its type diagram and colimit cocone take step 2. Compose e_j and b with Equiv.ulift. The source equivalence is Equiv.refl. The transition equation is the stage equation from step 1. For every stage element, colimit.iota_desc reduces the comparison on its inclusion to its cocone leg, and the apex equation from step 1 gives the required perfectLimitMap equation. This constructs every witness, including for the empty open.

theorem perfect_hom_open_colimit_local_comparison
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R)
    (i : I) (X : Scheme.{u}) (s₀ : X ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s₀] [QuasiCompact s₀] [QuasiSeparated s₀]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X))
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (t : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion t]
    (ht : W ≤ t.opensRange)
    (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) (hs : s = t ≫ s₀)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s]
    [∀ B : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over B))]
    (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hP : Y.IsPerfect P) (hQ : Y.IsPerfect Q)
    (F : Set.Ici i ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory Y) (d : Cocone F)
    (h : PerfectHomPushPullData R c s Q F d) :
    let H := schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y (t ⁻¹ᵁ W) ⋙
      schemeDerivedDirectImage (t ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι
    let T := (preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (Opposite.op P)).shift (0 : ℤ) ⋙
      AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u}
    PerfectHomLocalComparison R c i X s₀ W
      (colimit.desc (F ⋙ H ⋙ T) ((H ⋙ T).mapCocone d))
